name: Quick Apps
author: samara-hub-ro
description: A quiet launcher in the Omarchy bar: your applications in your own categories, one hover away — drawn in your theme's two colours, with a row that learns what you open at each hour, one-click switching to what is already open, and a details card for every app.

barWidget.description: Your applications by category, one hover away from the bar. A "now" row that learns your daily rhythm, a marker on what is already open, fuzzy search across everything installed, and a details card with version, install and update dates.

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: Show the panel when the pointer rests on the bar icon. With this off, the icon opens on click and the keybinding still works.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer has to sit on the icon before the panel opens. Raise it if the panel appears while you are passing by.

schema.label: Close delay (ms)
schema.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves the icon and the panel, so crossing the gap between them does not close it.

schema.label: Columns
schema.description: How many applications sit side by side before the grid wraps. This is what sets the panel's width.

schema.label: Icon size (px)
schema.description: Size of each application icon in the grid.

schema.label: Show application names
schema.description: Print each application's name under its icon. Turn it off for a tighter, icon-only grid.

schema.label: Maximum height (px)
schema.description: How tall the category grid may grow before it scrolls inside the panel. The now row sits above it and is not charged against this.

schema.label: Background opacity (%)
schema.description: Opacity of the panel and its details card. 100 follows your theme exactly; lower is more see-through — pair it with a Hyprland blur layerrule for a frosted panel.

schema.label: Show the now row
schema.description: A row at the top with the applications you are most likely to want at this hour, learned from when you open them — on weekdays and weekends separately once there is enough history. Keys 1–9 launch them when the panel is opened from the keyboard.

schema.label: Now row length
schema.description: How many applications the now row shows. It never wraps, so it is also capped by Columns.

schema.label: Mark open applications
schema.description: Draw a short accent bar under an application that already has a window open — a dot for one window, a longer bar for several.

schema.label: Switch to open windows
schema.description: Clicking an application that is already open switches to its window instead of starting another copy; with several windows, each click moves to the next. Middle-click or Shift+Enter always opens a new one.

schema.label: Show what open apps cost
schema.description: A small section at the bottom of the panel with the CPU and memory of open applications, a three-minute CPU line, and the heaviest few by name; the details card adds each one's CPU, memory, TCP traffic since it was first seen, and a Force quit button. Sampled every 3 seconds, in the background too, so traffic totals cover connections that open while the panel is shut.

schema.label: Show the details card
schema.description: Resting the pointer on an application slides out a card beside the panel: version, when it was first installed and last updated, size, package, and how often you open it.

schema.label: Details delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer has to rest on an application before its details card appears. Once it is up, moving to another application updates it at once.

schema.label: Sort tiles by launch count
schema.description: Order the tiles inside each category most-launched first, instead of the order you arranged them in. Applications you have never opened keep their stored order, and turning this off puts everything straight back — the sort never rewrites your file.

schema.label: Count launches from elsewhere
schema.description: Also count an application when it is opened from a keybinding, the Omarchy menu, a terminal or anything else, by watching for its window. Turn this off to count only what you launch from this panel.

schema.label: Fill categories on first use
schema.description: The first time the panel opens with nothing in it, build a starting set of categories from the applications you have installed.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Glyph shown in the bar. Leave it empty for the drawn mark — a downward triangle with an S cut out of it — or put any character your bar font carries here to replace it.

schema.label: Categories file name
schema.description: Name of the file the categories are stored in, inside ~/.config/omarchy/ — for example work.json. Empty means quick-apps.json. The file is always in that directory: a name with a path in it is ignored and the default is used.
